messages.content: Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence. Write 10 prompts to generate portrait images on the occasion of Mother's Day about the Palestinian mother and imagine her as a tree with roots clinging to the ground, as a gift to her on this occasion. Make some prompts into an expressive painting of an old Palestinian mother with wrinkles filling her face and her look full of kindness and tenderness.

message.content:
1) A tender Mother's Day portrait of a Palestinian mother as an olive tree with roots clinging to the ground, gentle face, soft light, 🌸
2) An expressive oil painting of an old Palestinian mother with wrinkles filling her face, kind eyes, and a tender expression, her body transforming into a rooted tree, 🌿
3) A symbolic portrait of a Palestinian mother whose arms become tree branches and whose roots hold the soil, Mother's Day flowers around her feet, 🌷
4) A warm digital painting of a mother in a Palestinian keffiyeh with roots wrapping around her ankles, a gift of blossoming branches, 🕊️
5) An artistic portrait of a mother as a date palm tree with deep roots clinging to the earth, cradling a child, Mother's Day colors, 🌴
6) An expressive watercolor of an old Palestinian mother with deep facial wrinkles, a loving gaze, and roots growing from her heart into the ground, 💛
7) A respectful portrait of a Palestinian mother standing as a tree with strong roots, wearing a headscarf, soft dawn light and flowers, 🌅
8) A symbolic Mother's Day illustration of a mother whose hands become roots gripping the soil and whose face is full of kindness and tenderness, 🌻
9) A cinematic portrait of a Palestinian mother as a resilient tree, roots holding the ground, children and olive branches around her, 🫒
10) An expressive painting of an elderly Palestinian mother with wrinkled skin, tender smile, and tree roots clinging to the earth, a living Mother's Day gift, 🎁
